genome.object: an antique dark wooden chair with a red upholstered seat
genome.name: Chairgeist
genome.lore: An antique chair woke up after someone finally complimented its upholstery.

genome.object: a purple and gray hiking backpack with black straps
genome.name: Packgremlin
genome.lore: It hatched from a forgotten trail snack and now insists on carrying everyone else's problems.

genome.object: a silver laptop with a black keyboard
genome.name: Lapto gremlin
genome.lore: It hatched when someone pressed one too many keys at once.

genome.name: Specsquatch
genome.lore: It grew a personality after witnessing one too many blurry mornings.

genome.object: a large antique book opened to cream-colored printed pages
genome.name: Bookgeist
genome.lore: It woke up after someone finally read the footnotes aloud.

genome.object: a silver wristwatch with a colorful patterned dial
genome.name: Ticktroll
genome.lore: It swallowed a confetti cannon and has been running party time ever since.

genome.name: Strumlin
genome.lore: It hatched from a forgotten guitar case and has demanded an encore ever since.

genome.object: a black city bicycle with a front wire basket and rear rack
genome.name: Cycleclops
genome.lore: It came alive after someone finally remembered where they parked it.

genome.name: Sedantasm
genome.lore: A family sedan became haunted after its thousandth argument with a parking meter.

genome.object: a lit white taper candle in a brass chamberstick holder
genome.name: Wickling
genome.lore: A birthday wish missed its cake and possessed the candlestick instead.

genome.object: a black umbrella with a curved handle
genome.name: Umbrell Imp
genome.lore: It opened indoors once and has been collecting bad luck ever since.

genome.object: a silver metal pen with a measurement scale and removable cap
genome.name: Penzilla
genome.lore: It came alive after someone used it to draw outside the margins.

genome.name: Capyogre
genome.lore: A riverside mud pie came alive and immediately demanded a nap.

genome.object: a red mushroom with pale spots and a thick cream stem
genome.name: Shroomlin
genome.lore: It grew an enormous red hat so the forest would stop overlooking it.

genome.object: a white and pink orchid in a pale gray flowerpot
genome.name: Orchid imp
genome.lore: It grew tiny feet after overhearing that orchids need a little movement of air.
